cohort: 120 postpartum women in two accredited baby-friendly hospitals in southern Taiwan
finding: Women who underwent cesarean birth experienced higher postpartum fatigue scores, which were correlated with greater difficulty in baby-care activities and weaker maternal-infant attachment in the first 2 to 3 days postpartum.
mod_finding: Women who underwent cesarean birth experienced higher postpartum fatigue scores compared to those who had vaginal births.
